analysis.title: Nordic Alert: Nvidia beats expectations - Fed minutes tonight
key_insights: European and US equities fell again on 11/17 with tech under pressure and new cybersecurity worries after CNN reported network problems at the NSA. Euro Stoxx fell just over 2% and the S&P 500 fell 1%, while long-term yields edged lower.
Nvidia's after-close quarterly report on 11/17 beat expectations and guided to 75% revenue growth in 2028. SEB says this appears to be easing AI-sector concerns for the time being.
Asian equities are rising on 11/18 morning. Futures point to a slightly positive US open and a flat European open.

The Fed minutes are due the evening of 11/18. SEB says US data signal a resilient economy with elevated inflation pressure. Higher energy prices have slowed the decline in headline inflation and raised the risk of indirect effects such as transport costs.
The market prices nearly 80 bp of Fed hikes by September 2027, almost 40 bp more than two weeks earlier.
SEB sees early signs of rising goods inflation. High mortgage rates are creating barriers in housing and risk leading to larger rent increases. Wage inflation continues to moderate.

UK core inflation is expected to ease slightly on 11/18. SEB thinks the BoE is overestimating inflationary pressure after sharply raising its inflation forecast on energy prices, and that the market is pricing overly aggressive tightening. SEB's forecast is a final BoE hike in February, with upside risks to it.
The Swedish krona lost ground against all other G10 currencies on 11/17. The dollar weakened slightly against several majors.

Swedish government talks are deadlocked over the Left Party's demands for cabinet posts. Exploratory talks are paused for a week. The Speaker expects either a government or an extraordinary election to be announced before Christmas and New Year. SEB sees very limited direct market effects but continued policy uncertainty.

Today's calendar has central bank speeches from the ECB's Lagarde and the Riksbank's Hjelm, UK inflation data, and the APEC meeting in Shenzhen with Trump, Xi and Putin attending. The focus is trade policy, AI and US-China relations.

sector_views.rationale: Tech was under pressure on 11/17 on AI-sector and cybersecurity concerns. Nvidia's results are easing the AI worries for the time being.

earnings_insights: Nvidia reported quarterly results after the close on 11/17 that beat expectations. The report gives no EPS or revenue figures. Guidance is for revenue growth of 75% in 2028.

tension_points.bull_case: The BoE sharply raised its inflation forecast on direct and indirect effects of high energy prices, and the market prices significantly tighter policy.
tension_points.bear_case: SEB sees no support for such a sharp rise in short-term indicators and thinks the market anticipates overly aggressive tightening.
tension_points.what_invalidates: SEB says risks are on the upside for its forecast of a final BoE hike in February.
